_readme: PlanRouter config. Pure stdlib, Python 3.10+, no runtime dependencies. Run: pip install -e . && planrouter --config router.example.json --check ; then planrouter --config router.example.json . Point your coding agent at http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1 (OpenAI) or /v1/messages (Anthropic) with listen.api_key as the bearer token. Secrets use env:VAR so nothing lands in this file or in logs. A channel is any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint: a direct API key, a free tier, or a local bridge (one-api / new-api / CLIProxyAPI) that exposes a coding-plan subscription. Protocols are NEVER converted: /v1/chat/completions only reaches openai channels, /v1/messages only reaches anthropic channels. If a plan speaks a different protocol, put a bridge in front of it. On 429 / quota errors the channel is cooled for the upstream reset time (Retry-After, *-reset headers) or cooldown_minutes (default 300 = 5h, matching typical plan windows); the next healthy channel serves the request automatically. Transient 5xx/network errors cool for 30s with a half-open probe. Add X-Session-Id (or body.user) for 30-minute session stickiness so prefix caches survive; X-Route: cheap or model=auto:cheap selects a cheaper chain. Responses carry X-Routed-Via and X-Failover-Count. GET /health shows remaining cooldowns, GET /stats shows per-channel usage. For personal use with credentials you are entitled to; each provider's terms still apply.
